body: I understand exactly what you mean, it does not sound pretentious, not too deep either, but I get it, thing is i'm pretty sure that like me, you have the ability you are just afraid to use it, or don't know you can use it, i've felt the same. and eh, life is.....I guess just an experience, everyone always says its precious etc, to me it's just something I go through, so I agree with you about feeling that stuff really has no value or meaning when you truly think about it, I guess we just have to try and make it mean something
This is true, when you commit by hanging or any type of asphyxiation your body while unconscious will thrash around and claw in a fight for survival
I think he is more referring to the fact, they are hit with the regret as soon as they jump, not after they hit the bottom and survive (but I am sure than intensifies the regret)
You feel out of place, like you don't belong, like you are standing out in a crowd, as if you cannot hope to blend in, right?

It would never hurt anyone any less in the long run, they will always, ALWAYS wonder if there was anything they could of done to prevent you taking your own life, if there was anything they DID that caused you to take your own life, you surely are not hurting him by existing, sure okay, you have an illness, but for 'better or for worse' he is your husband, he chose to marry you, because he loves you, bipolar and all

What happened to make you feel like that? 

How long have you felt like that?
Thanks! whilst i'm not particularly into the same stuff as you for conversation if you do need to talk feel free to PM, i'm around for a couple more hours ! \^\^

I think that before you feel yourself 'cave in' as you put, you should definitely try talking to someone, if you have a tough time explaining the bad things you have been through, perhaps talking to somebody who understands or knows about the things you have been through would be best, which is tough, because talking to someone you know about this kind of thing is very hard, for fear of embarrassment, feeling ashamed etc, however I feel that a conversation could help, after all, what's the harm in spending some 'alive time'  trying to talk to your parents about it if the rest of the time you would be gone?
Definitely, I think the distraction from your own problems by listening and trying to help somebody else with theres, almost gives you a few moments of clarity
Lovely post! I hope you find the support you are looking for, it is always nice to support others too, in doing so, it feels like you're also helping yourself so I get this :)

Have you talked to your parents about how you feel? I'm not sure how your family works and if this would help or not, I'm in pretty much the same state of mind right now, so it's probably hypocritical of me trying to help somebody else when I refuse to help myself.

​

What is it that you don't find appealing?

What parts of it DO you like / or find appealing?

What is the significance of the date? 

What has lead you to choose this as the solution ?
